reader_summary.headline: Today we are breaking down the world’s fastest-growing sports league, The Indian Premier League.
reader_summary.overview: Today we are breaking down the world’s fastest-growing sports league, The Indian Premier League. The Indian Premier League, often shortened to IPL. There are 10 teams, 74 matches, and the competition starts and ends within 2 months. The biggest sports leagues tend to come with long histories.

key_points.text: The Indian Premier League, often shortened to IPL.
You can trace the NFL back to 1920, the NBA to 1946, and Formula 1 to 1950.
In stark contrast, the IPL and its teams were founded in 2008.
